raw: “I’d probably use my tennis practice as the destination, since I go there every week. It’s at 48 Court Lane. I’d give them the address first, so they know where they’re aiming for, then go through the route from my home, turn by turn. I’d try to mention landmarks rather than just say, ‘Turn here, turn there.’ I’d want to make sure I had the street names right, though, rather than give them a confident set of directions that sends them the wrong way.”
